reviews.text: Great vets so hard to find good vets these days that actually care about the animals first the prices later. I’ve got a lot of animals so I’m always in and out of the vets it’s always a great service and support.
Excellent vets and staff highly recommend 👌
Great staff, great service and the perfect location 👌 …
Great vet

Really good service and with the added benefit of great staff. I had cause to arrange an emergency appointment and was seen by Dermot of whom I cannot praise highly enough. He was thorough in his investigation and recommended a sensible course of action that will see our pet back to his old self.

Truly cannot thank the team at Rouken Glen vets, particularly Dermot, Helen and Alannah, enough for the level of care they provided to our cat. They were the third vets to treat Seamus after two exceptionally stressful bladder blockages. They unblocked him for the third time and did not stop investigating until they identified the root cause of the problem. Seamus is now on a new diet (had we taken the recommendation from VetsNow he would have been on food that would have worsened his condition) and is in the process of recovery. We are so grateful for their diligence and compassion, we regret not coming to you sooner.

An actual vets that cares about animals rather than profit.
Been going for almost 10yrs and wouldn’t think of going anywhere else. They also have a mobile vet that can come to you, makes it easy if you have nervous animals.
The best vet practice with the best vets.
Great experience, straight to the point service and no overselling. They take care of pets with passion

Rouken Glen vets came highly recommended to me now I highly recommend them to you. I had to urgently contact them recently & I was in an absolute state & the second the receptionist answered the phone, her professionalism & care reassured me no end. Was immediately offered an appointment and within an hour I was there with my cat Brian. Every last little detail right down to the waiting area for the animals is well thought out. Our vet Helen was absolutely amazing & even contacted me out of hours with blood test results. This practice adore animals & care for their owners & it shows in every aspect of their service. No hesitation in recommending this vets.

We've been with Rouken Glen vets for a number of years now and would highly recommend them. Every time we have to use them we've found everyone to be friendly as well as professional and they've treated our cats so well over the years. Having the mobile service is brilliant as one of our cats is so traumatised when he goes in the car so that removes the stress. We moved from being at another vets in the area and it was the best thing we did - the service is incomparable and we feel like we and the cats are actually cared about.

We have one of our two dogs at Rouken Glen and we can safely say it is the best vet practice in Glasgow. From the vets to the nurses to the reception team, everyone who works there loves the pets being treated as much as the owners do. We will be moving our other younger dog back from Southside Vets on Fenwick Road as soon as we can after a recent terrible nurse experience and just how expensive they are compared to other vets in the area.

We love the honesty about this vets. It's reassuring and comforting to know that you are getting expert care and the prices are just so reasonable. Our dog is old and has restricted mobility. The nurses help us both in and out and never stop smiling when doing so. Thank you for so much love. Highly recommended if you are with other nearby vets to think about a change and come here.
I have lived with my dog in Dundee, Edinburgh and Glasgow. Rouken Glen Vets is the best practice we have been at and I do not hesitate to recommend their services to others.

Thank you so much for everything that Claire and the vet done today I’m so grateful yous are such amazing people and do a great job. It’s not a nice experience having to deal with the heartbreak of having to put your family cat to sleep but was in the best hands today thank you again to everyone that works at Rouken glen vets ❤️

Recently we had to have our beautiful 15 year old cat Indie pass in the gentle and loving care of Rouken Vets staff. They helped with cremation and when we arrived home from a short holiday we were greeted with a beautiful flower bouquet in memory of Indie. Thank you very much Tracey, Colm and family.

Was given a very warm welcome today by all the staff at reception. Impressed by thorough physical examination of my Border Terrier by vet Dernot who was informative and reassuring about a number of things. Very happy to have moved here from one of the big companies that bought out our formerly excellent vet practice in Ibrox.
Very helpful

Friendly staff & a nice waiting room & atmosphere
The vet nurses saw was lovely& so good!
Our dog stood on broken glass. We called vet, they took us in instantly, and kindly removed glass from his paw. Lovely staff and great service. Thanks guys

To be fair vets are good and friendly,  shame about the staff on reception who are quite the opposite to the point of being rude. We have moved to Southside Veterinary Clinic on Fenwick Rd- What a difference!
Very helpful staff, you feel a friendly atmosphere there, all vets are professional and willing to explain my pets condition in detail. Highly recommended !!!
Great, but expensive.

Sadly we had to say goodbye to our wonderful Cocker Spaniel Joe yesterday. The care and dignity afforded him and us was wonderful and helped us on this sad occasion. Joe was 15 in April & when we got him as a pup 15 years ago RGV was newly opened. We registered him there and he enjoyed the puppy classes. Special thanks to Dermott, Richard, Hetty and all other staff for looking after our special boy for 15 years. He had various health issues and his long life is a testament to the wonderful care he received from Rouken Glen Vets throughout his life 🐾

We took our Frodo to Rouken Glen surgery when he was 7 years old. For 13 years he was cared for by the wonderful team. He reached the grand old age of 19 years and 11 months thanks to the help of these wonderful vets. Sadly we had to say goodbye to our darling Frodo on Wednesday, it was very calm and compassionate form everyone involved, thank you all. Thank you to Catriona and Dermot who spent quite a time with Frodo over the years and to Martin who helped  Frodo with a mystery breathing problem. Thanks also to Shaun and reception staff for their compassion at a very difficult time. I would highly recommend this wonderful veterinary surgery.
All the staff are lovely and our wee rescue cats are well looked after.
♥️   D O C T O R   D E R M O T
lovely friendly helpful team. thanks for all your help!
Wonderful vets. Gentle and thorough. I can't praise them highly enough.
Great vet staff are friendly and helpful 👍 …

Really great vets, knowledgeable and compassionate.

Was especially thankful for the emergency appointments at short notice, at pricing far fairer than other vets we had spoken to before.

Would highly recommend, and we will definitely be visiting again for our future pet needs.

Have tried quite a few vets over the years, we have stuck with Rouken Glen, consistently provides great treatment for our pet. Prices are very reasonable for what our pet needed. Would recommend anyone looking for a reputable vet.
Best Vets in Scotland 😁 …
They don't bother to reply to emails.

Recently moved to this vet after 12 years with another practice. So far very impressed by communication, professionalism and level of service.

Update: After more than 2 years, I'm still very happy with this practice.  I'd highly recommend it if you're looking for a kind and efficient local practice which takes great care of pets and is very considerate of their accompanying humans!
Take great care of our kittens
Fantastic founder led independent veterinary practice
So far have been lovely and reasonablly priced too

It's hard to find a good vet, so I'm really glad I've found Rouken Glen. They do reasonably priced house calls which is great when 4 cats need jags. And they quite literally saved the life of my youngest when he managed to poison himself. I'd give more than five stars if I could.
Very thorough & professional
Cheeky staff

Great help and advice from the staff  our new kitten wasn't very well I had been recommended this vet's practice and I am so glad I went.
Big thank you to the staff
Very friendly place
I'm interested in exploring new foods and areas, I'm living in Glasgow the beautiful city
Amazing & caring vet. They’re knowledgeable, professional and kind with animals & us! Fair prices too!
Again we have to thank Dermot and Rouken Glen vets. Once again he has literally saved the life of another of our furry family. Thank you for the great care S&D C
